internal.title: High Latency Incident in Ad Service Due to CPU Saturation
internal.body:
At 12:20 UTC on 2026-11-08, we received an alert for high latency in the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion caused by CPU saturation at 98% utilization, confirmed by the activation of the adHighCpu flag. The latency p95 spiked to 1.8 seconds. Concurrently, the frontend and checkout services also experienced elevated latency and CPU usage but were secondary to the ad service issue.

The mitigation involved disabling the adHighCpu flag at 12:40 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery with latency dropping back to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to 0.12 seconds). The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Key timeline:
- 12:20:52: Alert received
- 12:40:41: Diagnosis confirmed CPU saturation in ad service
- 12:40:48: Flag disabled after approval
- 12:40:48: Recovery verified

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Latency Issue in Ad Service Resolved
external.body: Between 12:20 and 12:40 UTC on November 8, 2026, customers experienced increased latency in the ad service. The issue was identified and resolved by our operations team, restoring normal service performance. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
